item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong evidence of a Sharif-led 2024 program specifically aimed at protecting women, children, minorities, or displaced people from targeted violence or neglect. The positive evidence is mostly reactive, prison-specific, or counterterrorism-oriented. The negative evidence is broader and better documented, especially for Ahmadiyya abuse, migrant vulnerability, and weak punishment of abusive officials.","evidence":[{"title":"World Report 2024: Pakistan","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/pakistan","summary":"HRW reported that, after its prison-health reporting, Sharif ordered measures to improve sanitation and healthcare in Lahore Central Prison and vowed prison reforms nationwide. This is the clearest direct protection-related item, but it is reactive and prison-specific rather than a broad vulnerable-groups policy.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.4"]},{"title":"PM for collective efforts to eliminate menace of terrorism","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-06-22","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/22-06-2024/pm-for-collective-efforts-to-eliminate-menace-of-terrorism","summary":"Sharif launched a national counterterrorism campaign with provincial consensus and said the armed forces would be supported with necessary resources. This can be read as protecting residents from insurgent violence, though it is not targeted specifically at women, children, or minorities.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"PM condemns Besham attack, says perpetrators will be brought to justice","publisher":"Press Information Department, Pakistan","date":"2024-03-27","url":"https://pid.gov.pk/site/press_detail/24838","summary":"After the attack on Chinese nationals at Besham, Sharif condemned the killing of civilians and said the perpetrators would be brought to justice swiftly. This is a limited accountability-and-protection signal for civilians, but it is reactive and not tailored to vulnerable domestic groups.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.4","3B.6"]},{"title":"End escalating attacks on minority Ahmadiyya community","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-21","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/","summary":"Amnesty documented arbitrary arrests, police harassment, and orders blocking Ahmadi rites, while authorities failed to ensure safety. This is strong evidence against effective protection of a targeted minority.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Pakistan widening crackdown on dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"HRW said the government clamped down on dissenting media, the opposition, and NGOs, and that deportations of undocumented Afghans occurred without safeguards against police abuse. This is evidence against protection of vulnerable migrants and against a safe administrative environment.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.2","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Pakistan","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128431.html","summary":"The report says the government rarely took credible steps to identify and punish officials who committed abuses. That undercuts any claim of systematic protection for vulnerable groups or meaningful prevention of targeted violence.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on peoples' rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/","summary":"Amnesty condemned the election-day telecom and mobile internet shutdown as a rights violation. This is not a targeted-vulnerability case, but it shows a coercive climate around Sharif’s ascent that cuts against a general protection reading.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.6"]}]}
